cards.stem: How many impeached officials were found guilty and removed from office?
options: only eight officials were found guilty by the Senate and removed from office
cards.quote: Of those who were impeached, only eight officials were found guilty by the Senate and removed from office.
cards.hint: Check the sentence about being found guilty and removed.

cards.stem: How many impeachments have been recorded despite many proceedings being started?
cards.quote: The House has initiated impeachment proceedings more than 60 times. But there have been only 21 impeachments.
cards.hint: Look for the count of actual impeachments versus proceedings.

cards.stem: Which officials were all of those found guilty and removed?
cards.hint: See which office holders make up the entire guilty and removed group.

cards.stem: What happened to the three presidents impeached by the House after their Senate trials?
cards.quote: Presidents Johnson, Clinton, and Trump remained in office following acquittals by the Senate on all charges.
cards.hint: Find the result for Johnson, Clinton and Trump after acquittals.
